integrity: Proof establishes the infinite-family result. Exact enumerations corroborate only finite cases. Prior literature originality search may miss equivalent earlier work; 1994 primary full text not accessible.
limitations: Finite real paths; endpoint-preserving three-point median; strictly positive independent edge-variation weights; no wider windows, alternate endpoints, graph branches, vector values or two-input results for those classes. First-public day is the earliest verified to day precision among the cited primary sources; earlier 1987/1994 publications lack verified exact days.
title: Sharp two-input variation sensitivity of three-point median smoothing on finite paths
